You and Erskin sort it out.|Perrin Fertha and Mon Mothma discuss Klavin|audio=Klavin-OneYearLater.flac|}} '''Klavin''' was an individual who served as a [[governor]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[4 BBY]], he attended the [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of his friend [[Perrin Fertha]]'s [[Gender|daughter]], [[Leida Mothma]], and fellow [[Chandrilan]] [[Stekan Sculdun]], arriving at the [[Mothma Estate]] on the [[planet]]''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' [[Chandrila]] in a new [[starship]]. The vehicle took two of the limited number of spaces on the estate's docking platform and its crew were not eager to move when [[Mothma family]] [[Aide|assistant]] [[Erskin Semaj]] politely asked them to. Semaj then reported the parking issue to Leida's [[Parent|mother]], [[Mon Mothma]], who blamed the issue on Klavin's ego and told Semaj and Fertha to deal with it since the governor was Fertha's friend. ==Behind the scenes== Klavin was mentioned in "[[One Year Later]]," the first episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Klavin |ja=クラヴィン |ka=კლევინი }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Planetary governors]]
